messages:
liz: Heads-up: NexusWorks (HW + SI) wants a public marketplace tile and joint launch in ~5 weeks. They uploaded a SOC excerpt, a firmware SBOM, and a short security questionnaire. We need to triage mandatory listing artifacts and call out any supply-chain/CVE gaps.

aaron: quick read: SBOM present but unsigned, firmware signing not documented, incident response section sparse. Potential blocker: public tile requires signed attestations for device firmware.

zara: agree. i'll own firmware/SBOM attestation asks. will request signer fingerprint, signing process, and proof-of-verification on devices.

marco: infra note: we require evidence of key custody (KMS/HSM) if signing keys are used, plus an exportable key policy or attestation doc. Also telemetry retention needs to match marketplace baseline.

sec-bot: auto-flag: questionnaire missing admin MFA, supply-chain provenance claims unverified. Report: https://redwood-sec/reports/1790012345-qna

liz: ok team. proposed minimal artifact manifest for NexusWorks: 1) SOC excerpt mapped to our marketplace controls; 2) signed SBOM or SBOM + signature verification steps; 3) firmware signing attestation (key custody + verification flow); 4) KMS/key policy excerpt OR attest; 5) pen-test summary covering device/edge/infra with CVE list + remediation ETAs; 6) IR playbook excerpt + breach notification contact; 7) telemetry/log retention evidence.

aaron: for pen-test: accept vendor report only if it enumerates firmware/bootloader/OS CVEs and remediation timelines. otherwise we request a scoped re-test (budget up to 6 hours).

zara: firmware attestation template I'll send — minimal fields: signer name, signing algorithm, key storage type (HSM/cloud/local), verification mechanism, sample signature header. Also request statement on secure boot and root-of-trust.

marco: presign helper: i'll create presigned upload links once liz confirms manifest. default expiry 72h; can extend to 7 days by request. Tagging: marketplace:partner=nexusworks required.

liz: timeline: notify partner today, artifacts due in 8 business days (they requested extra time for procurement), internal validation 3 business days, redaction and publish checks 2 business days. announcement only after signoff.

sec-bot: scheduled reminder: nexusworks-compliance-review in #partnerships at 1790015000

aaron: redaction owner? we need a named person to scrub PII/field-customer data from screenshots and logs. product-security should sign off final public artifacts.

zara: i'll coordinate redaction with product-security. can someone confirm we require SBOM in SPDX or CycloneDX? i'd prefer SPDX.

liz: SPDX preferred but accept CycloneDX if signed. add format note to the intake.

marco: logging retention baseline: "Marketplace public tiles must retain security/audit logs 90 days; evidence should include storage path and lifecycle policy." i'll paste exact snippet into the intake doc.

liz: sample intake message to NexusWorks (snip): "Please upload the manifest items to the Redwood intake bucket using presigned links. Tag uploads with marketplace:partner=nexusworks. Include checksums, redact external customer PII, and provide contact for SOC owner and SRE lead for follow-up" :thumbsup:

aaron: supply-chain extra ask: if 3rd-party firmware components exist, request supplier attestations or CVE mitigation proofs for those components.

zara: added. also request device verification logs showing signature checks on boot for one sample device image. redacted is fine.

marco: ops-bot: presign-config is ready. liz, confirm expiry extension if you want 7-day uploads.

liz: Confirm extend to 7 days for NexusWorks. i'll send intake now. Ping me for escalations. :thumbsup:
